title: log
summary: List target-ref commits since its merge base with HEAD, newest first.
purpose: List target-ref commits since its merge base with HEAD, newest first.

fields.name: target_ref
fields.description: Target ref; option-shaped values and revspecs are forbidden. Omitted: the token group's work base (the project base without a group) start point — origin/<branch> when origin is ahead, else <branch>.

fields.name: max_count
fields.description: Maximum commits to return; a positive integer.

fields.name: side
fields.description: target=merge-base..target_ref (default) / head=merge-base..HEAD. Use side=head to see commits that exist only on HEAD.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
Only target-ref commits after the merge base are returned, newest first (side=head switches to the HEAD side).
The server cap is 1,000 commits; truncation is reported.
side=head sees commits that exist only on the authorized group worktree's HEAD (not on target_ref); side=target (default) sees target_ref's own changes.

errors.when: The ref is missing or the merge-base/log git command failed.
The ref, path, or max_count has an invalid form, or side is neither head nor target (reason=invalid_side).
This token does not have the read scope.
